alignments.note: Jussive verb rendered *bless*; the ASV fronts the subject name before it, so the unit stands after t001 under rule 25.
Explicit subject noun taking only its own English word (rule 20).
Ablative `מִן` rendered by the multi-word preposition *out of*, headed on the token carrying the lexeme under rule 24.

Anarthrous participle used substantivally; no article morpheme is present, so the supplied *he that* joins the participle's own unit under rule 46 and the head goes to the word carrying the lexeme (rule 31). The competing reading would head on *he*, but rule 46 expressly ranks the substantive's own lexeme above a pronoun the ASV supplied.

Appositional *Even* standing before a phrase no object marker and no connective morpheme reaches. The clause writes no waw and no `אֵת` here, so under rule 16's limit and rule 14's closing sentences no morpheme licenses the word and it is its own `added` unit; it is not folded into the participle's unit standing beside it (rule 42's reasoning about a surplus *and*).

review_notes: `עֹשֵׂה` is an anarthrous substantival participle, so its supplied *he that* joins its own unit under rule 46 and is not `added`; the head is *made*, not the supplied pronoun.
*Even* is marked `added`: the verse writes no object marker for it to stand on and no connective morpheme in that colon, so neither rule 16's appositional *even* nor rule 14's connective reaches it.
